name: Rewizz
tagline: Helping teachers get their time back.
summary: Teachers already have the material. Rewizz turns existing lesson content into revision packs. By default your material stays on your own computer.
headline: Rewizz helps teachers get their time back.
metaDescription: Rewizz is a private-beta 204Labs product that helps teachers turn existing curriculum and lesson content into revision packs.

sections.title: Who it is for
body: Teachers who already have lesson material and want revision packs without rebuilding everything from scratch.

sections.title: How it works
body: Choose existing curriculum or lesson content, review what is selected, adjust it and export the result.

sections.title: Privacy and control
body: By default your material stays on your own computer. You decide what is selected, changed and exported.

sections.title: Joining the beta
body: Rewizz is in private beta. Use the link above to ask for access by email.

name: bAIsect
tagline: For when building with AI gets you almost there.
summary: AI gets you most of the way, then the problem turns stubborn. bAIsect turns it into a structured issue report and connects you with engineers who can fix or finish it.
headline: bAIsect is for when building with AI gets you almost there.
metaDescription: bAIsect is a 204Labs product in development that turns a stubborn AI-build problem into a structured issue report and connects builders with engineers.

sections.title: Who it is for
body: Builders using AI who have reached a problem that needs clearer diagnosis, structure or an engineer's help.

sections.title: How it works
body: bAIsect turns your messy problem into a structured issue report, then helps connect you with engineers equipped to diagnose, fix, finish or improve the work.

name: Sevaya.lk
tagline: Answers from official sources, with the source beside every one.
summary: Sri Lankan public information in plain language: guides, jobs, exams and tenders, in Sinhala, Tamil and English. Sevaya.lk is independent and is not a government website.
headline: Sevaya.lk gives answers from official sources, with the source beside every one.
metaDescription: Sevaya.lk is a 204Labs product that presents Sri Lankan public information in plain language, with the official source shown beside every answer.

sections.title: Who it is for
body: People looking for information on Sri Lankan public services, job vacancies, exams and tenders.

sections.title: How it works
body: Answers are drawn from identified government and public-authority sources, and every answer shows its source. The service is available in Sinhala, Tamil and English.

sections.title: Independence
body: Sevaya.lk is an independent service. It is not a government website and is not operated by the Government of Sri Lanka.

sections.title: Launch
body: Sevaya.lk opens to the public soon. Sign up on the site to be notified at launch.

name: FlatIntel
tagline: Know more before you sign the lease.
summary: Renters usually learn what a building is like after moving in. FlatIntel turns verified tenant experience into building-level insight, and gives owners a fair way to respond.
headline: FlatIntel helps renters know more before signing the lease.
metaDescription: FlatIntel is a 204Labs product in development that turns verified tenant experience into building-level insight for renters.

sections.title: Who it is for
body: Renters who want building-level insight before committing to a lease.

sections.title: How it works
body: FlatIntel is being built to turn verified tenant experience into structured, building-level insight. Owners and property managers get a fair way to respond, explain and show what has improved.

sections.title: Availability
body: FlatIntel is being built and is not yet open to the public.
